the strongest contribution is not "Only-knowing = Zero" or "TELL/ASK = KnowledgeOS kernel." The real contribution is: Explicit Representation -> Reasoning -> Derived Knowledge plus Query 
eq Evaluation 
eq Determination and Logical Closure 
eq Operationally Available Knowledge and Subject-Matter Boundary 
eq Global Knowledge State and finally Successor-State/Persistence Semantics
